namespace flatbuffers {

template <typename T> inline static
typename FlatBufferOffset<T>::type build(FlatBufferBuilder& builder, const T& value)
{
    if constexpr (is_optional<T>)
    {
        if (!value.has_value())
            return 0;

{{~ for nullable in nullables ~}}
        if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, {{ nullable.type }}>)
        {
            return nullable::Create{{ nullable.table }}(builder, {{ nullable.value }});
        }

{{~ end ~}}
        return build<typename T::value_type>(builder, value.value());
    }
    else if constexpr (is_vector<T>)
    {
        if constexpr (std::is_fundamental_v<typename T::value_type>)
        {
            return builder.CreateVector(value);
        }
        else if constexpr (std::is_enum_v<typename T::value_type>)
        {
            auto buffer = std::vector<std::underlying_type_t<typename T::value_type>>();
            for (auto x : value)
            {
                buffer.push_back(static_cast<std::underlying_type_t<typename T::value_type>>(x));
            }
            return builder.CreateVector(buffer);
        }
        else
        {
            auto buffer = std::vector<typename FlatBufferOffset<typename T::value_type>::type>();
            for (auto& x : value)
            {
                buffer.push_back(build<typename T::value_type>(builder, x));
            }
            return builder.CreateVector(buffer);
        }
    }
    else if constexpr (std::is_enum_v<T>)
    {
        return static_cast<typename FlatBufferOffset<T>::type>(value);
    }
    else
    {
        return value;
    }
}

template <>
inline flatbuffers::Offset<flatbuffers::String> build<std::string>(FlatBufferBuilder& builder, const std::string& value)
{
    return builder.CreateString(flatbuffers::option::encode(std::string_view(value)));
}
